metadata.title: Cortex Development
metadata.description: Single-cell RNA-seq data from developing human cortex. SmartSeq2 protocol with 4,261 cells from embryonic brain tissue.

requirements.special_handling: Requires column name alignment between expression matrix and metadata

usage_examples.title: Basic Matrix Creation
usage_examples.description: Create a basic matrix table from cortex-dev dataset
usage_examples.code_snippet:
from hvantk.tables.ucsc import create_mt_from_ucsc_expression_matrix
mt = create_mt_from_ucsc_expression_matrix(
    expression_matrix_path='cortex-dev/exprMatrix.tsv.gz',
    output_path='cortex_dev.mt',
    min_partitions=4
)
usage_examples.expected_output: MatrixTable with ~4261 columns and variable rows

known_issues: Column name mismatch between expression matrix and metadata
Requires bgzip for proper compression handling
Memory intensive for full dataset processing
alternative_approaches: Use sample validation with --sample-lines 100 for testing
Process in chunks for large-scale analysis

metadata.title: Alzheimer's Disease Across Six Brain Regions
metadata.description: Single-cell RNA-seq data from Alzheimer's disease patients across six brain regions. Part of the ROSMAP project with over 1.3M cells.

usage_examples.title: Large Dataset Processing
usage_examples.description: Process the large AD multi-region dataset with memory optimization
usage_examples.code_snippet:
# Recommended for large datasets
from hvantk.tables.ucsc import create_mt_from_ucsc_expression_matrix
mt = create_mt_from_ucsc_expression_matrix(
    expression_matrix_path='ad-multi-region/exprMatrix.tsv.gz',
    output_path='ad_multi_region.mt',
    min_partitions=16,
    force_bgz=True
)

known_issues: Extremely large dataset requiring significant memory
Processing time can be several hours
Requires distributed computing for full processing
alternative_approaches: Use subset analysis by brain region
Consider cloud-based processing for full dataset

metadata.title: The Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) project v8
metadata.description: Comprehensive RNA-seq dataset from GTEx project version 8, covering multiple human tissues and providing baseline expression data.

requirements.special_handling: Requires SDRF file for sample metadata

usage_examples.title: GTEx Matrix Creation
usage_examples.description: Create a matrix table from GTEx v8 data
usage_examples.code_snippet:
from hvantk.tables.matrix_builders import build_expression_atlas_mt
mt = build_expression_atlas_mt(
    expression_matrix_path='E-GTEX-8-transcripts-tpms.tsv',
    sdrf_file='E-GTEX-8.condensed-sdrf.tsv',
    output_mt='gtex_v8.mt',
    min_partitions=8
)
usage_examples.expected_output: MatrixTable with GTEx tissue samples and transcript TPMs

usage_examples.title: Tissue-Specific Analysis
usage_examples.description: Filter GTEx data for specific tissues
usage_examples.code_snippet:
# Load and filter for brain tissues
mt = hl.read_matrix_table('gtex_v8.mt')
brain_mt = mt.filter_cols(mt.tissue.contains('Brain'))
usage_examples.expected_output: Filtered MatrixTable with brain samples only

alternative_approaches: Filter by tissue type before processing

metadata.title: Human RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
metadata.description: Time-series RNA-seq data covering development of 7 organs (brain, cerebellum, heart, kidney, liver, ovary, testis) from 4 weeks post conception to adulthood.

requirements.special_handling: Time-series data with developmental stage metadata

usage_examples.title: Developmental Time-series Analysis
usage_examples.code_snippet:
from hvantk.tables.matrix_builders import build_expression_atlas_mt
mt = build_expression_atlas_mt(
    expression_matrix_path='E-MTAB-6814-transcripts-tpms.tsv',
    sdrf_file='E-MTAB-6814.condensed-sdrf.tsv',
    output_mt='human_development.mt',
    min_partitions=6
)
usage_examples.expected_output: MatrixTable with developmental samples across organs

usage_examples.title: Organ-Specific Development
usage_examples.code_snippet:
# Filter for brain development
mt = hl.read_matrix_table('human_development.mt')
brain_dev = mt.filter_cols(mt.organ == 'brain')
# Sort by developmental stage
brain_dev = brain_dev.order_cols(brain_dev.age_weeks)

metadata.title: Chicken RNA-seq time-series of the development of seven major organs
metadata.description: Time-series RNA-seq data from Gallus gallus covering development of 7 organs from day 10 post-conception to day 155 post-hatch.

requirements.special_handling: Non-human species requiring appropriate gene annotations

usage_examples.title: Comparative Development Analysis
usage_examples.description: Create matrix for chicken developmental data
usage_examples.code_snippet:
from hvantk.tables.matrix_builders import build_expression_atlas_mt
mt = build_expression_atlas_mt(
    expression_matrix_path='E-MTAB-6769-transcripts-tpms.tsv',
    sdrf_file='E-MTAB-6769.condensed-sdrf.tsv',
    output_mt='chicken_development.mt',
    min_partitions=4
)

usage_examples.title: Cross-Species Comparison
usage_examples.code_snippet:
# Load both human and chicken data
human_mt = hl.read_matrix_table('human_development.mt')
chicken_mt = hl.read_matrix_table('chicken_development.mt')
# Use ortholog mapping for comparison

known_issues: Ortholog mapping needed for cross-species analysis
alternative_approaches: Use ortholog databases for gene mapping
